mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, user_name, user_role, nick_name, birth_date, phone_number, my_team, social_provider, gender ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{userName}, #{userRole, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.UserRoleTypeHandler}, #{nickName}, #{birthDate}::date, #{phoneNumber}, #{myTeam, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BaseballTeamsTypeHandler}, #{socialProvider}, #{gender, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.UserGenderTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT email, user_name, nickname, gender, profile_photo_url, my_team, phone_number, user_role, birth_date, transfer_number, receive_number, panelty_point FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{userPatchRequest.nickName}, profile_photo_url = #{userPatchRequest.profileImageUrl}, my_team = #{userPatchRequest.myTeam}, gender = #{userPatchRequest.gender} WHERE email = #{email}
